message: macro `defU` has a rule that can never match: rule 2 is shadowed by rule 1
notes: rules are tried IN ORDER and the first whose pattern matches wins (macro-system.md MAC-LANG-18); an earlier rule of the same arity whose elements are all plain binders matches every invocation of that arity, so nothing of that arity after it is reachable
help: give the earlier rule a pattern that can FAIL - a literal, or a parenthesised shape of two or more elements - or delete this one. A one-element `(p)` is the bare binder `p`: the parentheses are the same ones an argument loses, so it still matches everything
